title: If Organic Food Was Honest - Honest Ads
summary: Satirical Honest Ads sketch mocking organic marketing, natural pesticides, fraud and the lack of health benefits.

assertions.quote: healthwise organic food actually has no measurable leg up on the competition
organic produce accounts for 8% of ecoli outbreaks despite being just 1% of the food supply

verdicts.note: Systematic review (abstract only): E. coli contamination risk did not differ between organic and conventional produce.
Organic standards permit certain plant or microbial extracts and copper- and sulfur-based crop protection products.
Of 385 pesticide substances authorised in the EU, 26 are also approved for organic agriculture, including pyrethrins and copper.

7 CFR 205.206(e) lets organic producers apply biological or botanical substances or National List synthetics to control pests, weeds and diseases when cultural, mechanical and physical methods are not enough, so organic farming does use pesticides.
